channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Carta revela que Flávio Bolsonaro ofereceu “equipe de transição” aos EUA se vencer eleição
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed in a letter to U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio that, if elected president in October, he would make his transition team available to the United States to negotiate a broad bilateral trade and investment agreement. Rubio’s letter thanked the offer and noted the senator’s optimism about the election. Brazilian law stipulates that the transition team is only formed after the election results are finalized.

item.title: O barraco de Michelle e o rolo Master de Wagner contam como o país funciona
item.description: A recent video by Michelle Bolsonaro, former First Lady, sparked controversy by promoting a new far-right narrative, potentially influencing the 2026 election by drawing supporters who might otherwise back Flávio Bolsonaro. The content suggests a strategy of ideological polarization aimed at consolidating a parallel base to the official Bolsonaro movement, risking fragmentation within the conservative electorate. Its electoral relevance lies in the intra-right competition for votes in a tightly contested race.

item.title: Valdemar defende Flávio e diz que Bolsonaro o escolheu
item.description: PL president Valdemar Costa Neto defended Flávio Bolsonaro as the party's presidential candidate for 2026, stating he was chosen by Jair Bolsonaro. The comment followed a public clash between Flávio and his stepmother Michelle Bolsonaro, who accused him of disrespect and exclusion from party decisions. Flávio called for party unity, while Michelle said she no longer speaks to him after the phone call.

item.title: Marília reforça desejo ao Senado e defende aliança com PSB e MDB
item.description: Marília Campos, PT’s pre-candidate for the Senate, stated she resigned as mayor of Contagem under the condition of running for the Senate and is currently negotiating an alliance with PSB, MDB, and possibly PDT to form a broad front in Minas Gerais. She argues this unity is essential to compete strongly for the Palácio Tiradentes and views the decision to run a standalone candidacy as a mistake. National PT president Edinho Silva will visit Minas to meet with her, while state PT leaders support her for governor, though she resists that option.

item.title: Rubio agradece convite de Flávio para equipe de transição se eleito
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio thanked Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for offering to make a transition team available to the U.S. government if elected president in October. Rubio affirmed the United States’ readiness to cooperate with Brazil’s future leadership on broad, fair, and mutually beneficial trade and investment agreements. He also noted that, under Brazilian law, a transition team can only be formed after the election results are finalized.

item.title: Flávio volta a falar em união depois de atrito público com Michelle
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) called for unity among Bolsonarists after a public clash with his stepmother Michelle Bolsonaro, who accused him of disrespecting her over his support for Ciro Gomes (PSDB) in Ceará. He stressed that the 2026 election is about Brazil’s future over the next 50 years, not just Bolsonaro or Lula, and advocated lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro reafirma preferência por vice “qualificada”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro reiterated his preference for a qualified woman as his vice-presidential running mate in the 2026 presidential race, speaking at a PL event in Goiânia. The statement came days after a public disagreement with Michelle Bolsonaro, the former first lady, and included praise for Ana Paula, though her full name was not specified. He emphasized that the vice-presidential pick would be based on competence and ideological alignment.

item.title: O desconforto do PT com a prisão de vereador do partido em São Paulo
item.description: The arrest of PT councilman Senival Moura in Operation Última Parada exposes an alleged money laundering scheme linked to the PCC via the bus company Transunião, raising suspicions about the financing of PT campaigns in São Paulo. Investigators suggest criminal faction funds may have irrigated Fernando Haddad’s gubernatorial bid and bolstered Lula’s national project, though no direct evidence yet ties the party leaders to the scheme. The case creates discomfort within the PT, threatening to link the party to criminal structures in public transport — a strategic sector for its electoral base.

item.title: Flávio reforça expectativa de mulher na chapa e diz querer vice qualificada e disposta a colaborar
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's pre-candidate for President of Brazil, stated in Goiânia that he hopes to have a vice-presidential running mate as qualified as the woman chosen by the party for the Goiás gubernatorial ticket. He reinforced the expectation of female inclusion on the presidential ticket and emphasized the need for a collaborative and well-prepared partner.

item.title: Em meio à crise, Valdemar diz que Flávio foi escolhido por Bolsonaro
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro was chosen by Jair Bolsonaro as the party's presidential candidate for 2026, emphasizing that the former president does not make mistakes in his choices. The remark was made during the launch of the PL's majoritarian pre-candidacies in Goiás, without referencing the rift between Flávio and Michelle Bolsonaro.

item.title: Como o ex-deputado Daniel Silveira pode atrapalhar uma eventual anistia a Bolsonaro
item.description: Former deputy Daniel Silveira presents a significant legal obstacle to any amnesty attempt for Jair Bolsonaro, as the Supreme Federal Court annulled in 2023 the presidential pardon granted to Silveira by Bolsonaro, establishing that no pardon can erase attacks on the Rule of Law. Legal experts and constitutionalists argue that amnesties aiming to 'forget' the January 8 events violate the 1988 Constitution, as they undermine the guarantee of non-repetition and weaken the Rule of Law, regardless of the target.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro define briga com Michelle como 'página virada'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that his disagreement with his stepmother, Michelle Bolsonaro, is a resolved matter, describing it as a 'page turned'. He attributed the tension to stress from his father Jair Bolsonaro's health issues and emphasized his focus on the presidential pre-campaign. The senator took part in a pilgrimage in Goiânia and avoided confirming whether he had direct contact with Michelle after the incident.

item.title: O que faz Cleitinho segurar o embarque do Republicanos na pré-candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Cleitinho, a Republicanos senator and potential Minas Gerais gubernatorial candidate, is resisting announcing his candidacy alongside Flávio Bolsonaro, as party sources believe Flávio needs Cleitinho’s support more than Cleitinho needs Bolsonaro’s. This dynamic is delaying the party’s alignment with Flávio’s presidential pre-candidacy, especially given polls showing 30% of voters support a Cleitinho-Lula ticket.

item.title: Roberto Reis na Crusoé: O primeiro eleitorado pós-Lula
item.description: The June Datafolha poll shows Lula leading with 41% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 31% in the first round, but the author argues the real significance lies not in Lula’s lead, but in the electorate that won’t mourn his potential defeat — signaling a post-Lula voter base that is more fragmented and less emotionally tied to the PT.

item.title: Jaques Wagner volta a defender inocência e cita fala de Lula: 'só quem sabe o que você fez é você'
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT) reiterated his innocence regarding suspicions tied to a Federal Police operation investigating payments linked to Daniel Vorcaro's Banco Master, calling the accusations lies. He quoted a statement attributed to Lula: 'only you know what you did,' to stress that only he knows the truth about his own actions.

item.title: STF tem maioria para liberar penduricalhos retroativos
item.description: The STF has formed a majority of 6 votes to authorize retroactive payment of 'penduricalhos', including accumulated vacation, prize leave, and on-duty shifts prior to the March ruling, provided they are indenizatory and capped at 35% of the constitutional ceiling. The Court also approved immediate payment of the career seniority valuation parcel (PV TAC), reinstating the quinquennium system, while replacing fixed monthly health allowances with a reimbursement model requiring proof of expenses. Ministers are now reviewing appeals regarding alleged omissions and ambiguities in the March decision, which had initially capped benefits at 35% of the ceiling plus an additional 35% as a service-time gratuity.

item.title: Jorginho Mello rebate críticas de Lula: “Ele não entrega nada”
item.description: Santa Catarina Governor Jorginho Mello (PL) rebutted President Lula's criticisms, claiming the president 'delivers nothing' to the state and denying he had refused federal investments, asserting Lula fails to fulfill promises during his visits.

item.title: A segunda batalha de Carla Zambelli para tentar evitar extradição para o Brasil
item.description: Former deputy Carla Zambelli, sentenced to five years and three months in prison for illegal weapon possession and illegal constraint after chasing a man with a gun on the eve of the 2022 presidential election runoff, fled to Italy. The Brazilian government is seeking her extradition for this case, following the rejection of the first request — related to hacking the National Justice Council’s computers — by Italy’s Court of Cassation, which ruled that Minister Alexandre de Moraes improperly served as both judge and victim. Zambelli’s lawyer expects the second request to also be denied, while the STF and Italian legal scholars maintain the Brazilian proceedings were lawful.

item.title: Flávio e PL de Goiás lançam candidaturas em evento de apoio mútuo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) attended an event in Goiânia to launch the PL's majoritarian candidacies in the state, alongside gubernatorial pre-candidate Wilder Morais. He was honored with awards and greeted by conservative supporters, signaling strength for the Bolsonarist project, despite family tensions with Michelle Bolsonaro and controversies over his ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: A crítica de rival de Jaques sobre postura de petista após ser alvo de operação da PF
item.description: João Roma, former minister and Senate rival of Jaques Wagner, criticized Wagner's posture after being targeted by PF's Compliance Zero operation, saying his attempt to normalize the allegations damaged his image more than the investigation itself. Roma called it a 'scandal' and 'shame' that Wagner likened a banker buying an apartment for his daughter to buying a popsicle at the beach. Wagner stepped down from Senate government leadership six days after the operation, following a talk with Lula.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro associa PCC ao PT depois de prisão de vereador
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) linked the Workers' Party (PT) to the PCC following the arrest of São Paulo city councilor Senival Moura (PT), accusing the party of ties to a multimillion-dollar organized crime scheme and claiming Lula protected criminal factions. He also reiterated his call for the U.S. to designate the PCC and CV as terrorist organizations, referencing the MPSP's Operation Última Parada, which seized R$ 194 million and arrested Moura on money laundering suspicions via a bus company.

item.title: Marília Campos elogia nomes do MDB e PSB e falará com Lula contra candidatura do PT em MG
item.description: Marília Campos, former mayor of Contagem and PT member, once again rejected pressure from President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and the PT to run for governor of Minas Gerais in 2026. She publicly praised figures from MDB and PSB as viable alternatives, signaling her support for a non-PT candidacy. This move highlights growing internal party tension over the PT’s candidate selection in MG.

item.title: Empiricus manda vender ações de banco que defendeu Lula
item.description: Empiricus, the analysis arm of BTG Pactual, issued a report advising the sale of BR Partners shares one day after its CEO, Ricardo Lacerda, stated that Lula’s re-election does not pose institutional risk, but a potential victory by Flávio Bolsonaro could. The recommendation was exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Flávio critica Lula por fala sobre racismo e defende SC
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) criticized President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) for claiming racism prevails in Santa Catarina and referencing Adolf Hitler in a speech in Itajaí. Flávio defended Catarinenses as hardworking and honest, accusing Lula of not knowing Brazil and lacking moral integrity to hold the presidency. The conflict between Lula and Governor Jorginho Mello (PL-SC) was also highlighted, with the president accusing the governor of disrespect for skipping federal events.

item.title: Pivô de crise com Michelle no Ceará posta apoio de Flávio em vídeo e chama para evento de campanha
item.description: Alcides Fernandes, PL senatorial candidate in Ceará, received support in a video from Flávio Bolsonaro, who invited him to a campaign event on July 10. His candidacy was publicly questioned by Michelle Bolsonaro, who criticized the PL's alliance with Ciro Gomes and the replacement of Priscila Costa. Alcides responded by accusing Michelle of making unfounded claims and aiding the PT, stating that the right alone cannot defeat Elmano de Freitas.

item.title: Aliado de Flávio diz que Michelle aceitou aliança com Ciro em abril
item.description: Alcides Fernandes, an ally of Flávio Bolsonaro, claims Michelle Bolsonaro agreed to an alliance with Ciro Gomes in April, provided Priscila Costa would be the PL’s Senate candidate in Ceará. The statement was made in a video released on Friday (June 26), amid a family rift between Michelle and Flávio Bolsonaro, after she said she felt mistreated for publicly questioning the Ceará directory’s support for Ciro. Michelle’s chief of staff denied the pact, saying she only demanded party loyalty and support for Priscila Costa’s candidacy.

item.title: Segundo avião da FAB decola neste sábado com ajuda para a Venezuela
item.description: Brazil will send a second humanitarian flight by the FAB to Venezuela this Saturday, carrying a naval field hospital, 100 solar-powered water purifiers, and 48 military personnel to assist earthquake victims from June 2026. The mission was authorized by President Lula and follows the first flight that arrived on Friday with 12 tons of aid. Official Venezuelan figures report 920 deaths, 3,360 injuries, and over 4,000 displaced due to the quakes.

item.title: Escândalo dos respiradores pode virar dor de cabeça eleitoral para candidatos
item.description: The ventilator scandal involving the Northeastern Consortium's advance payment of 48 million reais to Hempcare for undelivered pandemic equipment may electorally affect Rui Costa (PT), Renan Filho (MDB), and João Azevêdo (PSB), though only Costa is under STF investigation. Political opponents plan to leverage their consortium membership as a campaign liability in 2026, despite Renan and Azevêdo not facing inquiries.

item.title: Irmão relata morte de brasileira do DF em terremotos na Venezuela
item.description: Brazilian Vanessa Zacarias da Silva, 44, died in the June 24, 2026 earthquakes in Venezuela, according to her brother Thiago Nogueira. She had been living in La Guaira for two months with her Venezuelan partner. The Itamaraty confirmed the death of one Brazilian man and one Brazilian woman without releasing names, while Brazil dispatched search and rescue teams with humanitarian aid.

item.title: Em vídeo, Flávio Bolsonaro reforça apoio a pivô de crise com Michelle
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) recorded a video supporting the pre-candidacy of Alcides Fernandes (PL) for the Senate in Ceará, inviting supporters to the official campaign launch on July 10. The video reinforces the alignment between the Bolsonaro clan and Fernandes’ candidacy, positioning it as part of the party’s political strategy in the state.

item.title: Em carta, Marco Rubio agradece a Flávio Bolsonaro por colocar 'equipe de transição' à disposição dos EUA caso seja eleito
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio thanked Flávio Bolsonaro for offering a transition team to be made available to the United States, should the senator be elected president in October 2026. The letter, dated June 23, 2026, was a response to prior correspondence from the parliamentarian and his recent visit to Washington, emphasizing U.S. optimism about the Brazilian elections and readiness to cooperate on trade and investment. Flávio Bolsonaro had previously stated that, if elected, he would immediately make his transition team available to the U.S. to expedite a mutually beneficial trade and investment agreement.

item.title: A ‘dobradinha’ que faz chefe da Fazenda acreditar em mais investidores gringos na bolsa brasileira
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan announced during a visit to China a partnership between B3 and Wind to make Brazilian corporate data available on global financial information platforms, aiming to attract more foreign investors to Brazil's stock market. Supported by the Ministry of Finance, the initiative seeks to enhance transparency and information access to strengthen the business environment. Sources suggest that its success could politically benefit President Lula by gaining favor with the financial market segment, which currently leans toward pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Agentes foram à casa de Bolsonaro após tornozeleira perder sinal
item.description: Police visited Jair Bolsonaro's residence after his electronic ankle monitor lost signal on the 19th, but found the device intact and functioning. Bolsonaro had previously attempted to tamper with the monitor in November 2025 using a soldering iron, leading to preventive detention. The report also notes Flávio Bolsonaro's visit to his father on the 24th and Michelle Bolsonaro's video accusing the senator of mistreatment.

item.title: Dark Horse: STF impõe sigilo 3 a caso do filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: The STF has placed under level-3 secrecy the request to investigate the financing of the film Dark Horse by banker Daniel Vorcaro, filed by deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) against Jair Bolsonaro and his sons Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro. The case examines whether funds originally intended for the film were redirected to support Eduardo Bolsonaro’s international activities in the United States. Relator was assigned to Minister André Mendonça by prevention, following a decision by Minister Edson Fachin.

item.title: Rogério Marinho defende aproximação com Ciro Gomes para derrotar Lula
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN) advocated for a political rapprochement with Ciro Gomes (PSDB), the pre-candidate for governor of Ceará, despite Ciro's recent criticisms of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ). Marinho believes a regional alliance between PL and PSDB could weaken the PT in Ceará and strengthen the PL in national contests, particularly aiming to defeat Lula in 2026. The strategy seeks to build an opposition front in the Northeast, even amid occasional disagreements between allies.

item.title: Governador de SC diz que Lula mente e o chama de “cara de pau”
item.description: Santa Catarina's governor, Jorginho Mello (PL), accused President Lula of lying about a claimed R$ 24 billion federal infrastructure offer for the state. Mello said the figure refers to a rejected toll road concession project on state highways, and that he resolved the BR-101 issue without raising taxes. He called Lula a 'shameless person' and claimed the president only visits to provoke Santa Catarina.

item.title: Eleições: a causa que uniu PT e PL para pressionar Nunes Marques
item.description: Political parties, specifically the PT and PL, are collaborating to pressure TSE Minister Nunes Marques not to increase campaign spending caps for the 2026 elections. The coordination involved direct engagement between PT president Edinho Silva and PL president Valdemar Costa Neto in a joint effort to influence the tribunal's decision.

item.title: Cinco dos maiores partidos da Câmara ainda não definiram apoio na disputa nacional
item.description: Five of the eight largest parties in the Chamber of Deputies have not yet defined their national support for the 2026 elections, while PT, PL, and PSD have already declared presidential candidacies. The hesitation stems from evaluating Flávio Bolsonaro’s electoral viability, which has been questioned after revelations about his ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro, along with difficulties in securing strategic center-right alliances. Parties are weighing whether endorsing Flávio brings more risks than benefits, particularly regarding state-level ticket formation and future ministerial control in a potential government.

item.title: Michelle posa de coitadinha, mas usa silêncio calculado como escudo
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro is adopting a victim persona to gain public sympathy, but her calculated silence on deeper family secrets is a strategic move to undermine her stepchildren without dismantling the Bolsonaro clan she benefited from. Her ultimate goal is to rise as leader of the far-right, aiming to succeed Jair Bolsonaro by exploiting the family rift. The attacks on Flávio Bolsonaro are driven by electoral ambition, not moral opposition.

item.title: Master, ‘Dark Horse’ e os embates no Supremo
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Federal Court (STF) is facing intense internal conflicts over the Master case, which investigates alleged illicit financing tied to former President Jair Bolsonaro and his family, including possible funds used for Eduardo Bolsonaro’s self-exile in the U.S. While STF President Edson Fachin assigned André Mendonça as rapporteur of the crime notice, tensions have escalated, with ministers like Gilmar Mendes accusing others of attempting to obstruct the investigation. Meanwhile, the Electoral Superior Court (TSE) has seen a 335% surge in electoral complaints, with PT and PL leading disputes over content, AI use, and coalition rules, foreshadowing the 2026 election battle.

item.title: A menos de 100 dias da eleição, Flávio repete principal desafio de Bolsonaro em 2022: conquistar as mulheres
item.description: With less than 100 days until the 2026 election, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is repeating his father’s 2022 challenge: performing competitively among men but consistently trailing Lula (PT) among women, who constitute over half the electorate. Recent polls show Lula leading by significant margins among female voters in all second-round scenarios, while Flávio maintains a narrow edge among male voters, mirroring the gender divide observed in 2022.

item.title: Por que quatro países questionaram decisões da Justiça brasileira envolvendo tentativa de golpe
item.description: Four countries, including the United States and Italy, have questioned Brazilian judicial decisions involving Eduardo Bolsonaro and Carla Zambelli, citing concerns over judicial independence and impartiality. Eduardo Bolsonaro was sentenced to four years and two months for obstruction of justice, while Zambelli’s extradition was denied by Italy’s Supreme Court of Cassation due to doubts about the fairness of her trial. Both claim political persecution and remain abroad, joining over 500 others convicted of anti-democratic acts who have fled Brazil.

item.title: Vídeo de Michelle reaproxima Malafaia de Flávio
item.description: Silas Malafaia, a pastor who had recently distanced himself from Flávio Bolsonaro, called the Zero Um program on Wednesday night shortly after the release of a video by Michelle Bolsonaro to express solidarity with the senator. The call was made in response to the video, which appeared to resonate among Bolsonaro allies. The story is exclusive to subscribers of the outlet that published it.

item.title: PF indicia aliado de Lula por exploração ilegal de minério
item.description: Lucas Prado Kallas, a business ally of President Lula and member of the so-called 'Conselhão', has been indicted by the Federal Police over suspected involvement in an illegal mining scheme in the Serra do Curral, Belo Horizonte. Kallas is president of Cedro Mineração and a member of the Council for Sustainable Economic and Social Development (CDESS), an advisory body to the federal government.

item.title: Vídeo indica que Michelle já pensa no futuro bolsonarista sem Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro released a critical video targeting her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro, signaling a potential rift within Bolsonarism. The timing of the post suggests she may be positioning herself as a political alternative amid Jair Bolsonaro's weakening stature, possibly fragmenting the movement and benefiting Lula in the 2026 election.

item.title: Brasil ou Japão?
item.description: A poll of 1,036 readers shows 78.1% believe Brazil has better chances of winning in an implicit comparison with Japan, while 21.9% chose Japan. The content is linked to a series of articles and polls from Blog do Noblat, covering diplomacy, foreign economy, and culture.

item.title: Domiciliar de Bolsonaro chega ao prazo com direita desorganizada e Michelle protagonista de crise
item.description: The humanitarian house arrest period for Jair Bolsonaro ended without a judicial decision, as his absence from political articulations leaves the right-wing disorganized. Michelle Bolsonaro sparked a crisis by posting a video criticizing her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro and endorsing her ally Priscila Costa for a Senate seat in Ceará, causing a rift in the bolsonarist base. Allies complain that Bolsonaro's isolation hinders alliance-building and ticket formation in key states like DF, São Paulo and Ceará, potentially affecting Flávio's presidential pre-campaign.

item.title: Palanque de Lula em MG ganha ares de chantagem e petistas dão ultimato a Marília Campos
item.description: The PT in Minas Gerais is pressuring Marília Campos, the party's pre-candidate for Senate, to run for state governor, threatening to block her from running for any other office if she refuses. While the national PT leadership denies coercion, it plans a personal meeting between Edinho Silva and Marília, followed by a frank conversation with Lula, relying on the precedent of party members like Reginaldo Lopes who have yielded to Lula's requests. The situation highlights the tension between candidate autonomy and party discipline in Lula's strategy to maintain a standalone candidacy in Brazil's second-largest electoral college.

item.title: Flávio ignorou conselhos de buscar pacificação com Michelle antes de crise com vídeo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro ignored allies' advice to seek reconciliation with his stepmother, Michelle Bolsonaro, before the release of a video that triggered a family and political crisis. The lack of prior mediation contributed to the escalation of the conflict, which now impacts his 2026 presidential pre-candidacy under the PL party. The article highlights the failed containment strategy and its effect on his public image.

item.title: Charge do Miguel Paiva
item.description: Miguel Paiva's cartoon critiques Brazil's foreign policy under Flávio Bolsonaro, suggesting a strategic submission to the United States. The image implies the country is sacrificing its autonomy in exchange for American favors or protection, with a critical tone toward the government's approach.
